Fire Quirk.name: Fire Quirk
Fire Quirk.description:
🔥 You make real fire from your body.

🌱 At the start you throw flame jets and bursts out to about five meters, raise a fire screen between you and danger, and give light and heat on demand.
📈 With training: flame lances, signal flares, thrust leaps, fire lanes that stop a spreading blaze, steel-melting white heat, and flame shaped to spare a hostage.
⚠️ Holding back is the real skill: every burn you cause is yours to answer for.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Overheating, as heat builds inside your own body.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Endeavor (Hellflame), Dabi (Cremation).

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Control +10, Conditioning +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Ember Jet, Blaze Screen
🛡️ Resists: fire
Fire Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: flame from the skin, usually palms and forearms. At first: a jet about five meters, a doorway-filling burst, flame a few seconds per push; it lights wood, cloth and fuel; dirty flame makes thick smoke. More needs learned techniques. Limits: water, foam, rain and sealed rooms smother it; fire spreads to what it touches, smoke chokes allies too, and clothes burn unless fireproof. The user resists heat, not smoke, and cannot call back a fire that has caught. Quirk Strain: light: hand flame, short jet; moderate: fire screen, lance, flare, thrust leap; heavy: clearing a fire lane, melting steel; severe: signature move, flame shaped around people. Type: Emitter (also fits Mutant). Law: unlicensed public flame is a crime, burning a person assault; even licensed heroes answer for every avoidable burn. Look: none at rest; flame in the player's chosen color rolls off hands and arms with heat shimmer; as Mutant, a permanent mark such as flame hair or ember-lit skin.
